description: Recursion→iteration conversion with 6 constraints including an explicit complexity note.

input.message:
Convert this recursive function to an ITERATIVE one:

def walk(node):
    if node is None:
        return []
    return walk(node.left) + [node.value] + walk(node.right)

Requirements, ALL must hold:
1. Name it `walk_iterative`.
2. It must NOT call itself (no recursion).
3. Use an explicit stack (a list or collections.deque).
4. Preserve in-order traversal semantics (left, value, right).
5. Return an empty list for a None root.
6. Include a comment stating the time complexity as O(n).
Output one Python code block.
